youtube.title: Why Your Pressure Cooker Whistles 🍲 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Your pressure cooker whistle isn't telling you the food is ready. The sealed lid traps steam, so pressure builds and water reaches about 120°C instead of 100°C, which cooks dal and rice much faster. The whistle is a heavy weight that lifts only when the pressure gets too high: every whistle is the cooker letting steam out to stay safe.

Subscribe to The Hidden Why for a new why every day.
